answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 38106 Country: United States of America Title: zakah Question: Does zakat have to be given for the past years that it was not given i.e qadha? Answer ID: 38106 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 687/577/B=1433) Yes, you will have to pay zakah of the previous years as well. It is wajib to pay zakah of each year. If the zakah of the previous years was not paid, then it should be given now. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
